messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I plan to deploy a small UX hotpatch to the Console (header spacing + missing style) at 15:00 PT (in ~30m). Will invalidate CDN. Need one owner for rollback + someone to watch smoke (Sentry + frontend 5xx). :rocket:

Maria: I can take smoke watching. I'll monitor Sentry alerts, RUM errors, and the /console health probes.

Sam: I'll perform the invalidation and edge-priming. Using cloudfront-invalidate script in repo.

Alex: TY. Steps: 1) merge and CI -> prod build to s3 bucket 'console-assets-prod' 2) sam runs invalidation: `scripts/cf-invalidate --dist D123ABC --paths '/assets/*console*'` 3) run edge-prime: `curl -s https://console.example.com/_edgeprime || true` 4) smoke: visit main routes, check console logs, and run `curl -I https://console.example.com` ensure cache-control and 200.

Sam: Note — we should stagger invalidation to avoid high cache fill. I'll do phased invalidation: first /assets/xx then remainder.

Jia: Quick QA: the change affects only header css, no API changes. No DB migrations. LGTM.

Dev-Bot: CI pipeline passed for commit abc123 (main -> prod). Build artifacts uploaded.

Alex: Can someone be ready to rollback? The rollback steps: revert commit (git revert abc123 && push), run an incremental invalidation for assets from previous release tag `v1.28.4` (we keep old assets under /v1.28.4/), and kick the redeploy pipeline. Sam — you'll have the rollback command. :+1:

Sam: I have the rollback commands in my terminal. Will standby.

Maria: I'll watch Sentry, NewRelic frontends, and the Console dashboards. Ping me if you see error rate spike > 0.5% or main page latency > 600ms.

Alex: Deploying at 15:00 PT now.

Deploy-Bot: deploy_started: env=prod service=console user=alex commit=abc123

Sam: initiating phased invalidation now. step1 done.

Alex: Smoke checks: main console loads, login works, job view renders. Report any JS regressions.

Maria: getting one RUM error spike on /settings — looking.

Sam: step2 invalidation done. Edge-prime hit. `curl https://console.example.com/_edgeprime` returned 200.

Maria: RUM spike resolved — was a transient cache mismatch. No new Sentry errors.

Alex: Good. I'll leave it open for 10m before closing.

Sam: holding rollback ready. Tagging ops: @sre-oncall for FYI.

Sre-Oncall: noted, will watch infra metrics (edge latency / 5xx) for 15m.

Alex: all green after 10m. Closing rollout. Thanks everyone. :tada:

Deploy-Bot: deploy_finished: env=prod service=console commit=abc123 status=success duration=8m

Maria: adding short note to release channel and changelog.
